nodes.name: Policies
nodes.title: Policies
nodes.description: Beginning of a Subtree that contains all policies.

children.title: Policy GUID
children.dynamicNaming: The ApplicationControl CSP enforces that the "ID" segment of a given policy URI is the same GUID as the policy ID in the policy blob.

children.name: Policy
children.title: Policy
children.description: The policy binary encoded as base64. Supported value is a binary file, converted from the policy XML file by the ConvertFrom-CIPolicy cmdlet.

children.name: PolicyInfo
children.title: PolicyInfo
children.description: Information Describing the Policy indicated by the GUID

children.name: BasePolicyId
children.title: BasePolicyId
children.description: The BasePolicyId of the Policy Indicated by the Policy GUID

children.name: FriendlyName
children.title: FriendlyName
children.description: The FriendlyName of the Policy Indicated by the Policy GUID

children.name: IsAuthorized
children.title: IsAuthorized
children.description: Whether the Policy indicated by the GUID is authorized to be loaded by the enforcement engine on the system

children.name: IsBasePolicy
children.title: IsBasePolicy
children.description: TRUE/FALSE if the Policy is a Base Policy versus a Supplemental Policy

children.name: IsDeployed
children.title: IsDeployed
children.description: Whether the Policy indicated by the GUID is deployed on the system (on the physical machine)

children.name: IsEffective
children.title: IsEffective
children.description: Whether the Policy indicated by the GUID is Effective on the system (loaded by the enforcement engine and in effect)

children.name: IsSystemPolicy
children.title: IsSystemPolicy
children.description: TRUE/FALSE if the Policy is a System Policy, that is a policy managed by Microsoft as part of the OS

children.name: PolicyOptions
children.title: PolicyOptions
children.description: The PolicyOptions of the Policy Indicated by the Policy GUID

children.name: Status
children.title: Status
children.description: The Current Status of the Policy Indicated by the Policy GUID

children.name: Version
children.title: Version
children.description: Version of the Policy indicated by the GUID, as a string. When parsing use a uint64 as the containing data type

nodes.name: Tokens
nodes.title: Tokens
nodes.description: Beginning of a Subtree that contains all tokens.

children.title: ID
children.description: Arbitrary ID used to differentiate tokens
children.dynamicNaming: The ApplicationControl CSP enforces that the "ID" segment of a given token URI is unique.

children.name: Token
children.title: Token
children.description: The token binary encoded as base64. Supported value is a binary file, obtained from the OneCoreDeviceUnlockService.

children.name: TokenInfo
children.title: TokenInfo
children.description: Information Describing the Token indicated by the corresponding ID.

children.name: Status
children.title: Status
children.description: The Current Status of the Token Indicated by the Token ID

children.name: Type
children.title: Type
children.description: The Type of Token Indicated by the Token ID
